text:
Gold Price in 1978
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1978, the LBMA gold price rose 28.6% between 1978-01-31 ($176) and 1978-12-29 ($226). The highest sampled price was $243 in October and the lowest was $171 in April. The mean of these observations was $197. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
